title: podcast-explainer-video shared definitions
description: Definitions that several schemas share. The segment role enum lives here and only here: outline.schema.json and script.schema.json reference it, validate_script.py reads it, and references/learning-design.md section 4 describes each role.

role.description: Segment role. hook: cold open, puzzle and prediction. puzzle: a second puzzle or the series question. roadmap: the questions the episode answers. plain: the whole idea in everyday words, no terms. terms: name the parts already understood (plain meaning first, then the term). example: one worked example, step by step. mechanism: the causal steps or the formal rule. misconception: the wrong model voiced, shown to fail, corrected. analogy: one analogy, mapped, with where it breaks. transfer: the model in a new context. compare: against a neighbour concept. scale: edge cases and limits. check: retrieval question with a hold. recap: the learner explains back. selftest: hands the work to the learner (learn/ files, next-time question).

pause.description: A pause-and-think cue on a turn. The video shows the prompt card with a countdown ring for the turn's holdAfterMs, after the turn ends.

prompt.description: Short question shown on the card, at most about 12 words.

newTermLimits.description: THE authoritative new-term limits (A05). Per episode by depth; for deep, per part of a series. Per segment at most `perSegment`. validate_script.py reads the default below (W20); outline.schema.json newTerms maxItems equals perSegment; references/depth.md, learning-design.md and script.md quote these numbers and point here.

holdAfterMs.description: Extra silence after the turn, in ms, so the learner can think. 6000 to 8000 for a prediction or retrieval pause. tts.py adds it after the normal gap and records it in timing.json.
